beats.say: Spain has a land border with Morocco, in Africa.
beats.title: SPAIN BORDERS AFRICA

beats.say: Two Spanish cities sit on the African coast: Ceuta and Melilla.
They're full parts of Spain, and of the European Union. The EU's only land borders in mainland Africa.
Across the water, Europe and Africa are only fourteen kilometers apart, at the Strait of Gibraltar.
And the Rock of Gibraltar, on the Spanish side, belongs to Britain.
So Spain has a piece of Africa, and Britain has a piece of Spain. Follow for more.
beats.title: BORDERS MAKE NO SENSE
